mapper.insert: INSERT INTO federated_identity (provider_id, issuer, subject, user_id, display_name, email, last_login_at) VALUES (#{providerId}, #{issuer}, #{subject}, #{userId}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{lastLoginAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM federated_identity WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM federated_identity WHERE provider_id = #{providerId}
mapper.update: UPDATE federated_identity SET last_login_at = NOW(), display_name = #{displayName}, email = #{email}, gmt_modified = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
